sentences.text:
Heard Ms Snighdha Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Sagar Singh, the leanred counsel
for the complainant and learned Aga and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Fir No.722 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B Ipc
and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Kotwali Gangaghat, District Unnao.
3.  In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the son of the applicant on 05.02.2022 and sufficient dowry was also given.
Subsequently, the daughter was killed on 11.12.2023.

The postmortem report indicates the cause of death is ante mortem handing Malti Mishra vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. / ... on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191993994/
1 and apart from the ligature mark, no other substantial injury was observed except for two contusion injuries on the left and right thenar eminence.

entities.text: ante mortem handing Malti Mishra vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is argued that father-in-law of the deceased has been enalrged on bail vide order dated 21.03.2024.
4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the material on record, prima facie, there is no material against the applicant to suggest that soon before her death, the victim was subjected to any physical or mental harassment in relation to any demand of dowry coupled with the fact that the applicant aged about 60 years has no criminal antecedents and is languishing in jail since 14.12.2023, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Malti Mishra be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on her furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which she is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade her from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
